reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis of a strain-induced FCC-to-hcp transformation in FeNiCrMn is physically questionable, as this alloy system is a well-known stable FCC solid solution with no reported martensitic transformation, and the proposed mechanism lacks support from prior literature on this specific composition.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and would decisively falsify the hypothesis by directly searching for hcp phase via TEM/EBSD, but the requirement for real-time in situ TEM/SEM during dynamic loading is extremely challenging and impractical for split-Hopkinson bar conditions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (FCC-to-hcp transformation) that is highly unlikely for the stable FCC FeNiCrMn system, diverting attention from more probable mechanisms like dislocation slip and twinning that are well-documented in similar alloys.
